meta.title: Daymark
meta.description: Try Daymark in a throwaway WordPress. Opens the Daymark app with sample Marks and four made-up friends to follow.
meta.author: jeffpaul

files.daymark-demo.php:
<?php
/**
 * Daymark Live Preview: loads the made-up friends the preview follows.
 * See .github/blueprints/sample-friends.php in the Daymark repository.
 */
if ( file_exists( WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/daymark-demo/sample-friends.php' ) ) {
	require_once WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/daymark-demo/sample-friends.php';
}

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! class_exists( 'Daymark_Plugin' ) ) {
	return;
}

// A new WordPress comes with a "Hello world!" post. Take it out, so the
// Timeline opens on the demo.
$hello = get_page_by_path( 'hello-world', OBJECT, 'post' );
if ( $hello instanceof WP_Post ) {
	wp_delete_post( $hello->ID, true );
}

// Follow the made-up friends and read their posts.
if ( function_exists( 'daymark_sample_friends_follow' ) ) {
	daymark_sample_friends_follow();
}

// Sample Marks, one for each Mark type and Featured Content kind.
$seed = WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/daymark-demo/seed-sample-content.php';
if ( file_exists( $seed ) ) {
	require $seed;
}
